claim: The bundled demo audits five files and reports three identical, one changed, one missing, and one Live Photo pair.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:sample-demo' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run target/debug/mfa demo; inspect its generated manifest

claim: An audit never writes into or replaces a source or archive file.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:read-only-safety' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh source and archive trees; attempt existing archive and new in-source outputs; compare SHA-256

claim: The manifest records JPEG EXIF fields, MOV codec and frame rate, sidecars, and upper-case Live Photo pairs when present.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:media-observations' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: synthetic valid JPEG EXIF and ISO-BMFF fixtures plus upper-case HEIC/MOV fixture

claim: The CLI emits JSON summaries and returns exit 0 for a clean audit, 1 for differences, and 2 for errors.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:json-automation' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh clean, missing-file, and invalid-input fixtures

claim: The CLI needs no account or network connection.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:offline-local' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: run mfa demo with socket and connect syscalls denied by an LD_PRELOAD guard

claim: The static site sends no third-party requests and stores no browser data during the demo.
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture requests and browser storage through the complete /demo flow

claim: Media Fidelity Audit is free under the MIT License.
test: cargo build && npm run build:site && node --test --test-name-pattern='@claim:mit-license' site/tests/claims.test.mjs
sandbox: fresh checkout; inspect the shipped LICENSE
